title: 4 King Beds • Heated Pool • Grill • Game room
description:
Are you ready for some family fun? Experience The Cactus Pad.

Located in the heart of Gilbert, this home has been recently renovated and is perfect for the whole family. With a heated pool, basement game room, and a chef’s kitchen, you are sure to have enough space for everyone in the family.

This beautiful home sleeps up to 16 people with 5 bedrooms, a full kitchen, outdoor fire pit, Xbox, and more!

Have a question? Send us a message!

 The space 
Add our listing to your wishlist by clicking the ❤️ in the upper-right corner. Please note, there is an additional fee to heat the pool ($50/day). If you would like to heat the pool during your stay, please let us know at the time of your booking. :)

Laundry Room:

Prime Location📍:
👉 Fantastic overall location. 5 minutes to downtown Gilbert - which contains high-end restaurants and bars.

 Guest access 
Guests will have private and exclusive access to the entire home and backyard amenities. This includes all bedrooms, bathrooms, the kitchen, living areas, game room, and the private pool area.

For your convenience, entry is via a keyless smart lock.

Spaces Not Accessible to Guests:
 👉 The garage
 👉 Two locked storage closets used for host supplies

Ample parking is available in the driveway and the adjacent side paved drive.

 Other things to note 
👉 Pool Heating: The pool can be heated for an additional fee of $50 per day. Please provide at least 72 hours' notice before your arrival if you would like this service to ensure the pool is warm for your stay.
 👉 Security: For your safety and security, the property is monitored by exterior security cameras.
 👉 Property Maintenance: To keep the home in top condition, the pool is serviced weekly and landscapers visit once a month. These services are scheduled to be as minimally disruptive as possible.
 Family Owned: We are a family-run property and are dedicated to making your stay wonderful. Please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions!
